item.title: No Tumblr please
item.description:
I tried, I honsetly tried to get to use to Tumblr. But after some recent investigations I’ve realized there is no any solid way to edit blogs using Word 2013 or Microsoft Live Writer. So, no. I do not play web-only games, no value to use Tumblr.

So we switching to old good Blogger. And here we are again.
